name: AISkeletonText

props.name: heading
props.description: Generates skeleton text at a larger size.

props.name: lineCount
props.description: The number of lines shown if paragraph is true.

props.name: paragraph
props.description: Set this to true to generate multiple lines of text.

props.name: width
props.description: Width (in px or %) of single line of text or max-width of paragraph lines.

a11y.note: Carbon ships a11y behaviour per component; verify per screen

when_to_use: Use Carbon AISkeletonText rather than building one.
when_not_to_use: Do not restyle off-token — propose a token instead.
